    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==2]
    threes=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==3]

    for d in range(2,15):
        P={(r%d,c%d) for r,c in cells}
        slots={(r//d,c//d) for r,c in cells}
        if not slots<=P: continue
        missing=P-slots
        if not missing: continue
        if not all(sr*d+max(p[0] for p in P)<=br1 and sr*d>=br0 and

    for r,c in threes: g[r][c]=0
    origins=[( (r//d)*d,(c//d)*d) for r,c in cells]
